feature: Street-facing block by the 962 lane entrance, four photographed three-storey stacks of projecting balconies. Named current address group 1–4 contains additional buildings.
method: Six adjusted camera stations were fitted in project coordinates using four stair openings and two independent main-wall and slab-edge lines. Each new bearing uses its station rotation and the ratio of the two intrinsic projections. Raw study-camera sample pixels below are independent for each visible lip. Intersections use least-squares distances to rays. Upper and lower tiers were then read on separately rectified large views at each fitted depth.
frame_axes: X eastward and Y inward; Z estimated local street pavement. Cross-sections project outward to negative Y. All distances are image estimates.
source_permissions: Street panoramas were consulted for geometric measurements. Project evidence contains numeric transcriptions, source references and checksums; comparison images for publication are made from the original model.
uncertainty: The easternmost D stack is seen at steep angles through trees or wires. Individual middle-tier lines from the 2015 eastern view depart from the joint estimate by up to 0.40 m. The D upright x position follows the visible interruption relative to the free ends.
Views from the far east and west whose raw vehicle coordinates have no fitted window control were inspected for end profiles only and excluded from the depth fit.

The optical edge of a round return depends on viewing angle. Residuals at A left and C right include the selection of the tangent. Only the B middle radius was sampled as a curve point by point. Other end radii use visible profiles at their own spans.
Ground and soffit heights are not a level survey. Direct reach to the covered rear wall, slab back edge, metal fixings and concealed steelwork cannot be measured from the street.
colour: The December 2015 photographs show paler blue-grey dressed balcony bands. The model follows the warmer grey visible in the February 2020 street photographs.
attachment_note: Rear slab coordinates meet the measured supporting wall, with a small overlap at the joint. C and D wall offsets were cross-checked with the whole-front author.
